label: Code Attribute Quality Issues
description: Defects localized within individual code samples in the training dataset.

label: Non-Code Attribute Quality Issues
description: Defects in non-code textual data or macro-level properties of the corpus.

label: Correctness
description: Training code samples contain syntax logical functionality API or dependency defects.

label: Security
description: Training code samples contain vulnerabilities credentials or high-risk implementation patterns.

label: Compliance
description: Training code samples violate legal ethical or regulatory requirements.

label: Robustness
description: Training-code fault-tolerance, input-validation, exception-handling, or boundary-checking patterns; path-level direction and qualifiers distinguish stronger practices from deficits.

label: Maintainability
description: Training code samples have structures that are difficult to modify extend or reuse.

label: Understandability
description: Training code samples express logic or intent unclearly.

label: Efficiency
description: Training code samples contain resource-wasting or algorithmically suboptimal implementations.

label: Compliance and Security Risks (Textual)
description: Non-code textual training content is harmful copyright-infringing or privacy-leaking.

label: Distribution Imbalance Issues
description: The corpus is uneven across languages domains resources data types tasks or difficulty.

label: Redundancy Issues
description: The corpus contains duplicate near-duplicate or excessively repetitive samples.

label: Inadequate Diversity
description: The corpus insufficiently covers scenarios domains edge cases environments or solution forms.

label: Data Contamination Risks
description: Training data overlap with evaluation benchmarks or otherwise leak test solutions.

label: Low-Value Data
description: Training data contributes little useful learning signal or introduces noise and error.
